description:
About Airship

Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. Today, brands are challenged to deliver seamless, unified customer experiences across a fragmented array of channels and devices— apps, websites, email, SMS, wallets and more. 

Airship’s no-code, AI-powered platform was designed with non-technical, growth-focused teams in mind, making it easy to create, test and orchestrate hyper-personalized experiences across all channels. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships.

We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day.

To learn more about us, visit www.airship.com, read our blog or follow us on LinkedIn.

About the Role

Do you love helping brands build text message programs that customers actually want to get? This could be your role. You’ll be Airship’s go-to expert on SMS marketing strategy and compliance. You’ll work directly with some of the world’s best-known brands to design and grow high-performing SMS programs.

You’ll join Strategic Services, part of Airship’s Professional Services team. Our consultants and campaign specialists partner with leading brands to design, build, and improve mobile engagement programs across app, SMS, and other channels. They’re looking for someone to lead the SMS strategy practice worldwide.

This is a senior individual contributor role with global reach and no sales quota. Your focus is expertise and customer results. You’ll guide customers through a complex and changing set of regulations. You’ll help brands moving from other SMS platforms get more out of the channel than ever before. You’ll also raise the bar for the whole team by building the playbooks, training, and standards that help everyone advise with confidence.

What You'll Do*

  • Lead SMS strategy for key customers: Run SMS strategy projects for strategic customers around the world. This covers everything from program reviews and goal-setting to subscriber growth, content, message timing, audience segments, and customer journey design.
  • Connect SMS with other channels: Design programs where SMS and app messaging complement each other to increase engagement and performance.
  • Be our SMS compliance expert: Serve as the go-to expert on SMS rules in the U.S., UK, and EU. You’ll design strategies that are compliant from the start, and you’ll know when to bring complex questions to our legal team.
  • Build and maintain playbooks: Create and update Airship’s global SMS best practices and compliance playbooks as mobile carrier rules and regulations change.
  • Guide migrations and onboarding: Build smooth migration plans for customers moving from other platforms, so their business keeps running and they see value quickly. Partner with onboarding project managers, lead consultants, and technical specialists to set strategy, success measures, and compliance foundations from day one.
  • Turn strategy into technical plans: Work closely with our technical SMS specialist on message delivery, registration, and setup. Together, you’ll turn big-picture goals into clear technical requirements.
  • Coach and grow the team: Mentor consultants and campaign specialists, lead internal training, and review SMS work across the team to keep quality high.
  • Support high-impact deals: Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic SMS opportunities. This includes conversations with customers considering a switch from another provider and presentations to senior leaders.
  • Share market insights: Track customer trends, market changes, and new technology such as Rich Communication Services (RCS), and share what you learn to help shape our product roadmap.
  • Work smarter with AI: Use AI tools to create efficiencies, automate processes, and free up more of your time for high-value strategic work.

*Duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

What We're Looking For

  • Mobile marketing experience: 6+ years in SMS or mobile marketing. That includes 3+ years advising brands on SMS strategy at an SMS platform, an agency, or a large brand.
  • Hands-on SMS compliance knowledge: Strong practical understanding of SMS regulations and industry standards. This includes the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA), CTIA messaging guidelines, 10-digit long code (10DLC) registration, U.S. state laws, and UK and European consent laws.
  • A record of measurable results: Proven success growing SMS programs against business goals such as subscriber growth, revenue, and customer retention. You test, learn, and let the data guide you.
  • Lifecycle marketing know-how: A strong understanding of lifecycle marketing and how SMS works alongside app messaging, email, and web channels.
  • Confident communication with senior leaders: Excellent communication skills. You have experience presenting complex regulatory and strategy recommendations to senior marketing and legal leaders.
  • Framework and playbook building: Experience creating frameworks, training, and standards that help a whole team grow its skills.
  • Global collaboration: You’re comfortable working across time zones with teams and clients in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.
  • AI Curiosity: You’re eager to use AI tools to work more efficiently and automate repetitive tasks.

We'd Be Delighted If You Also Have

  • Prior experience with a specialized SMS marketing platform, e.g., Attentive, Postscript, or Klaviyo
  • Experience leading complex SMS migrations from one platform to another
  • Familiarity with RCS, rich media, and two-way conversational messaging
  • Industry experience in retail, e-commerce, quick-service restaurants, media, or financial services

Work Location & Travel Requirements

Airship’s ‘Digital First’ approach to work means that for the majority of our roles, work can be performed remotely, either some or most of the time. Airship believes that flexible work contributes to a more productive and more equitable work environment, and that Airshippers are able to collaborate, innovate, and support one another across different locations and timezones.

Some roles may require that employees perform their work from a specific location to support business activities, and/or be within proximity to an Airship office location or customer or partner locations, while other roles can be performed 100% remotely. 

This position is fully remote and may require up to 10% travel based on business needs or as requested by your manager.

Compensation

Starting Pay Range: $105,000-$135,000 USD per year

This is a good faith estimate of the base compensation we reasonably expect to pay for this position upon hire. Actual starting pay may vary based on factors such as relevant skills, work experience, market demands, and location. All offers include stock options so employees have the opportunity to benefit from Airship’s success. 

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your dependents
  • Flexible time off, company paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid volunteer time off 
  • Support for your overall wellbeing with mental health and wellness resources
  • Employer-subsidized life insurance as well as short-term and long-term disability
  • A digital-first work environment and a monthly stipend to support remote work
  • Mentorship and growth opportunities to build skills and accelerate professional development
  • And more!

AI in Recruiting

We use artificial intelligence tools in our recruitment process as decision-support tools only. Airship's People Operations team reviews all AI-generated scores and recommendations before making any hiring determination. No applicant is rejected solely on the basis of an AI-generated output. Depending on your location, you may have the right to request human review of any AI-assisted employment decision or to opt out of AI evaluation. To make a request or learn more about how we use AI in hiring, contact privacy@airship.com or visit airship.com/legal.

California residents can view the CCPA disclosure notice here.

**Please Note: To ensure the security of your personal information, Airship will only contact candidates through email addresses ending with “@airship.com”.

Hiring Commitment

Airship is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We welcome your application and our hiring and employment decisions are made irrespective of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. In alignment with our commitment to equal opportunity, Airship will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a way that adheres to the principles of fairness and the requirements of local Fair Chance laws, where applicable.

By submitting this application, I affirm that the facts set forth in it are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that if I am employed, false statements, omissions, or misleading information given in my application, interview(s), or in a background check may result in dismissal.
